model_runs.name: Dim_date
model_runs.compiled_code: with date_spine as (            with rawdata as (                  with p as (         select 0 as generated_number union all select 1     ), unioned as (      select           p0.generated_number * power(2, 0)      +           p1.generated_number * power(2, 1)      +           p2.generated_number * power(2, 2)      +           p3.generated_number * power(2, 3)      +           p4.generated_number * power(2, 4)      +           p5.generated_number * power(2, 5)      +           p6.generated_number * power(2, 6)      +           p7.generated_number * power(2, 7)      +           p8.generated_number * power(2, 8)      +           p9.generated_number * power(2, 9)               + 1     as generated_number      from           p as p0      cross join           p as p1      cross join           p as p2      cross join           p as p3      cross join           p as p4      cross join           p as p5      cross join           p as p6      cross join           p as p7      cross join           p as p8      cross join           p as p9                )      select *     from unioned     where generated_number <= 729     order by generated_number    ),  all_periods as (      select (         timestampadd(day, row_number() over (order by generated_number) - 1, '2025-01-01')     ) as date_day     from rawdata  ),  filtered as (      select *     from all_periods     where date_day <= '2026-12-31'  )  select * from filtered    )  select      cast(date_format(date_day, 'yyyyMMdd') as int) as date_key,     date_day as full_date,     year(date_day) as year,     month(date_day) as month,     day(date_day) as day,      date_format(date_day, 'MMM') as month_name,     date_format(date_day, 'E') as day_name  from date_spine
